landing.eyebrow: स्मार्ट खेती की शुरुआत यहाँ से
landing.heading: बेहतर खेती के निर्णय।
landing.description: स्थानीय मौसम सलाह, मृदा स्वास्थ्य कार्ड विश्लेषण, कृषि इनपुट सत्यापन और बहुभाषी एआई वॉयस सहायता एक ही सुलभ मंच पर।
landing.featuresDescription: Access core agricultural services powered by AgriVoice Pillar APIs and voice assistance.
landing.weatherDescription: Monitor real-time field conditions, 7-day and 48-hour forecasts, extreme weather alerts, and stage-aware crop advisories.
landing.soilDescription: Import Soil Health Cards, review NPK and micronutrient ratings, check fertilizer dosages, and verify seeds or fertilizers.
landing.voiceDescription: Ask questions by voice or text in your regional language to get grounded weather, soil, and input guidance.
landing.loginTitle: आपकी खेती का डैशबोर्ड यहाँ से शुरू होता है।
landing.loginDescription: Sign in with your registered mobile number and OTP to connect your farms, weather forecasts, soil reports, and voice tools.

voice.title: एआई वॉयस सहायता
voice.subtitle: Speak or type in your preferred language to query weather, soil context, alerts, and input verification.
voice.assistantGreeting: Ask AgriVoice about today's farm weather, your Soil Health Card, active alerts, or product verification.
voice.inputPlaceholder: Ask a question or speak using the microphone...
voice.micUnsupported: Browser microphone recognition is unavailable here. Type your question or tap a quick prompt below.
voice.promptWeather: What is today's weather and forecast for my farm?
voice.promptSoil: Summarize my latest Soil Health Card and deficiencies
voice.promptAlerts: Are there any active weather alerts for my farm?

voice.groundingNote: Responses strictly use verified API measurements and never fabricate missing nutrient or forecast values.
